title: Automatic Transmission Assembly
introduction: I keep the transmission’s identity attached to its assembly instructions: “Mustang gearbox” is a family name, not an assembly recipe. This entry directs assembly to the matching transmission overhaul procedure. That procedure is unavailable here, leaving preparation, equipment, assembly sequence and completion checks unresolved. This page cannot serve as standalone assembly instructions.

items.name: Transmission overhaul procedure
items.detail: Obtain the linked overhaul procedure before beginning assembly.

edits.text: To assemble the transmission, use the transmission overhaul procedure. Refer to: [Transmission (307-01 Automatic Transmission - 6-Speed Automatic Transmission – 6R80, Overhaul)](#/document/G1692066).
edits.why: The matching overhaul procedure must supply the assembly sequence and its required checks. This referral contains no instructions for assembling individual components.
